prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a hit while turning left. The patient had 23 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1339; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was struck from the side while turning left. The reported mechanism, including the nature and force of the impact, is consistent with the cervical injury diagnosed, which is whiplash-type soft tissue trauma to the neck and upper back. Care was delivered over 23 visits and followed a typical course of rehabilitation: early visits focused on pain control and gentle range-of-motion work, with progressive strengthening added as symptoms eased. Visit frequency tapered steadily as the patient improved and reported less pain and stiffness.

Examination findings are mixed. Palpation revealed muscle guarding and reduced cervical range of motion, which support the injury, while several neurological screening tests returned normal results. The patient reports a remote history of a minor strain in the same region several years ago, which resolved completely without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single, appropriate charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries.

At discharge the patient was improving, with residual stiffness expected to resolve with a home exercise program.
